note: Private gated RV park on the east side of Bakersfield, about 2 minutes from CA-58 - a stopover between northern and southern California. Mostly seasonal: about 20 of its 120 sites are sold by the night, all paved 65-ft pull-throughs with patios and full hookups. Pool, hot tub, clubhouse, dog park, small store, metered propane. AAA and military discounts. --Claude
